Below is a **step‑by‑step playbook** you can follow to build a modern, production‑ready frontend for an e‑commerce site. I’ll cover the whole stack – from design to deployment – and sprinkle in best‑practice tips, tooling recommendations, and code snippets so you can jump straight into implementation. --- ## 1️⃣ Define the Scope & Architecture | Question | Why it matters | |----------|----------------| | What pages do you need? (Home, Category, Product, Cart, Checkout, Account, Admin) | Helps decide component hierarchy | | Do you need server‑side rendering (SSR) for SEO? | SSR (Next.js, Nuxt) gives better crawlability | | Will you use a headless CMS or a custom backend? | Determines API shape | | Do you need PWA features? | Determines service‑worker setup | | What analytics / marketing tools will you integrate? | Influences data layer design | ### Suggested Architecture ``` src/ ├─ components/ # Reusable UI widgets ├─ pages/ # Route‑specific components ├─ hooks/ # Custom React hooks ├─ context/ # Global state (cart, auth) ├─ services/ # API wrappers ├─ styles/ # Tailwind / CSS modules ├─ utils/ # Helpers (formatting, validation) ├─ assets/ # Images, icons └─ lib/ # Third‑party libs (Stripe, PayPal) ``` --- ## 2️⃣ Pick the Tech Stack | Layer | Options | Recommendation | |-------|---------|----------------| | **Framework** | React, Vue, Angular | **React + Next.js** (SSR + static export) | | **State** | Redux, Zustand, Context API | **Zustand** (lightweight) or **React Context** for small apps | | **Styling** | Tailwind CSS, Styled‑Components, CSS Modules | **Tailwind** (utility‑first, fast prototyping) | | **Type System** | JavaScript, TypeScript | **TypeScript** (type safety, IDE support) | | **Testing** | Jest, React Testing Library, Cypress | Jest + RTL for unit, Cypress for E2E | | **CI/CD** | GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI | GitHub Actions (free for public repos) | | **Deployment** | Vercel, Netlify, AWS Amplify | **Vercel** (native Next.js support) | | **Analytics** | Google Analytics, Plausible, Segment | Google Analytics + Plausible (privacy‑friendly) | | **Payment** | Stripe, PayPal, Braintree | **Stripe** (modern API, easy integration) | | **CMS / Backend** | Custom Node/Express, Firebase, Supabase, Shopify API | **Supabase** (Postgres + Auth + Storage) or **Shopify** if you want a managed solution | > **Why Next.js?** > • Built‑in SSR & SSG → better SEO & faster first paint. > • API routes → you can keep everything in one repo. > • Image component → automatic optimization. --- ## 3️⃣ Design & Prototyping 1. **Wireframe** – Sketch the layout on paper or use Figma. 2. **Component Library** – Build a design system (colors, typography, spacing). 3. **Accessibility** – Use WCAG 2.1 AA guidelines (contrast, focus states, ARIA). 4. **Responsive Grid** – Tailwind’s `grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4` pattern works well. > **Tip:** Keep a single source of truth for colors and spacing in a `theme.ts` file. --- ## 4️⃣ Build the Core Pages ### 4.1 Home Page ```tsx // pages/index.tsx import { GetStaticProps } from 'next'; import { fetchFeaturedProducts } from '../services/api'; export default function Home({ products }) { return (

Handle webhook events (`payment_intent.succeeded`) to update order status. --- ## 5️⃣ API Integration | Service | Endpoint | Example | |---------|----------|---------| | **Supabase** | `/api/products` | `GET /api/products?category=shoes` | | **Stripe** | `/api/create-checkout-session` | `POST { items: [{ id, quantity }] }` | | **Auth** | `/api/auth/login` | `POST { email, password }` | > **Tip:** Wrap fetch calls in a `services/api.ts` file and handle errors centrally. ```ts // services/api.ts export async function fetchProducts(query = {}) { const res = await fetch(`/api/products?${new URLSearchParams(query)}`); if (!res.ok) throw new Error('Failed to load products'); return res.json(); } ``` --- ## 6️⃣ Performance Optimizations | Technique | How | |-----------|-----| | **Image Optimization** | Use Next.js `` component. | | **Code Splitting** | Dynamic imports (`next/dynamic`). | | **Lazy Loading** | `loading="lazy"` on images, `IntersectionObserver` for heavy components. | | **Tree Shaking** | Import only what you need (`lodash/fp`). | | **Critical CSS** | Tailwind’s `@apply` + PurgeCSS (built‑in). | | **Caching** | `Cache-Control` headers on API routes; use SWR for client‑side caching. | | **Service Worker** | Vercel automatically registers a basic SW; add custom caching if needed. | --- ## 7️⃣ Accessibility & SEO | Feature | Implementation | |---------|----------------| | **Semantic HTML** | Use `
